heading: ## Project knowledge (pro-brain)
intro: Durable project knowledge (decisions, reasons, cautions) is kept as notes in `{path}`{sync}.
sync_suffix: and synced to the team brain from `{default_branch}`
lookup_label: Before answering why or what-did-we-decide questions
mode_issue-end: after `/pro-report` posts the issue report and before the issue is closed, run `/pro-brain` (one note per issue).
mode_session-end: at the end of a work session with meaningful changes, or right after a feature commit with `/pro-commit`, run `/pro-brain` (one note per topic of the change set).
mode_merge: when a branch or PR is merged into `{default_branch}`, run `/pro-brain` for that change set.
mode_manual: run `/pro-brain` only when someone asks to save knowledge.
lookup_with_brain: search the team brain MCP `{brain_mcp}` first; if it is not connected, read `{path}` (search it by topic, file or issue number).
lookup_without_brain: read `{path}` first (search it by topic, file or issue number).
rules: Skip trivial changes with a one-line reason. Never put secrets, personal data or chat content in a note.
direct_suffix: and also written directly to the team brain
intro_brain_only: Durable project knowledge (decisions, reasons, cautions) is kept as notes in each member's gbrain, not in the repo.
intro_brain_only_team: Durable project knowledge (decisions, reasons, cautions) is kept as notes in the team brain `{brain_mcp}`, not in the repo.
lookup_brain_only: search your gbrain MCP first (`/pro-brain status` shows where notes go).
lookup_brain_only_team: search the team brain MCP `{brain_mcp}` first (`/pro-brain doctor` checks the connection).
rules_brain_only: `/pro-brain` writes notes straight to the brain (`brain_cli.py write`); never commit notes to the repo. Skip trivial changes with a one-line reason. Never put secrets, personal data or chat content in a note.
